body:
Hi @hamidm thanks for posting this issue. When you say specific, does it mean that you already know which entries you want to display? I'd be curious to know more about your use case.

Just so that we are on the same page, widgets for facets in InstantSearch relies on the availability of the filters in the result set (the results computed in the search engine even those not displayed). This means that for any queries the values displayed are the ones available for filters. It's a contextual hint for the users. Fixing those values removes some help that could be provided to the end user.
